observed_failure: The guest native run exited 1 at seo_page_0_audit_wait. Its final sample had a valid linked SEO scope, an enabled Re-audit button, a Headings group, no visible audit error, and a null title.
boundary: The acceptance runner's DOM read of the rendered SEO Title row.
cause: SeoDetails > SeoGroup renders a header, then a card, then an inner divider containing SeoRow elements. The old runner treated the card's direct child as a SeoRow. Its Title label search could never find the row in that structure, regardless of whether the product rendered the title correctly.
correction: tests/browser/seo-guest-acceptance.mjs now descends into the card's inner divider before searching the Title row. The existing title equality, headings, re-audit, and error acceptance conditions remain unchanged.
evidence: test-results/seo-guest-acceptance.json: failure_stage seo_page_0_audit_wait and last_safe_observable title null, headings true, reAudit true, error false
src/features/seo/SeoDetails.tsx: SeoGroup wraps children in a card and inner divide-y element; SeoRow is a child of that inner element
